How did she go from a one-room cabin on Tennessee’s Little Pigeon River to the commanding heights of American celebrity? Why it matters: This blowup over the country's massive network of license plate readers illustrates how rapidly AI has moved from a peripheral issue in national politics toward the center of the midterm campaign. Data centers have become a major issue in the midterms, with candidates racing to one-up each other in their opposition to building the energy-hungry facilities. Parton shared the message to commemorate Eminem, whose real name is Marshall Mathers, being inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022. Read more at The Daily Beast.
